changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicates and ambiguous dataset references. Consolidated outputs description. Removed GPT-2 as it's already covered by 'GPT-2 based system'.
Normalized all variations of F0.5 metric to standard form and removed duplicates.
No LLMs used as judges in this paper - GPT-2 is used only as a generation/comparison model, not for evaluation.

guideline: - not attempting to rewrite the text nor make fluency edits, but rather to make minimal edits - minimum number of edits to make the text grammatical.

changes_made.explanation: Removed annotation guideline as it describes data creation process, not human evaluation of system outputs. The paper does not conduct human evaluation of generated outputs.

overall_notes: This paper focuses on grammatical error correction (GEC) evaluation. It uses automatic metrics (F0.5) but does not conduct human evaluation or use LLMs as judges. The extraction was generally accurate but needed normalization and removal of some ambiguous references.
